conclusions.text: All 215 issue subjects map to the exact 39 parent rows and five area ancestries in the pinned Atlas baseline.
The five area descendant counts match the pinned Atlas hierarchy and adjacent issue snapshots exhaust those target-area memberships.
Existing crosswalk source labels do not establish current legal boundaries or completeness for Chile or Paraguay.
